Attention, passengers on Flight two eighteen to Singapore. Due to heavy fog, all departures are delayed by approximately ninety minutes. We understand this is inconvenient. Passengers can collect a meal voucher at the service desk next to gate fourteen. Please keep checking the departure boards for updates, and we will make another announcement as soon as we have more information. Thank you for your patience.

Hi, Ms. Garcia, this is Daniel from Brightline Printing. I'm calling about the brochures you ordered for your trade show. We've finished printing them, but we noticed that the phone number on the back page is missing one digit. Before we deliver them, could you call me back to confirm the correct number? If we reprint today, the brochures will still be ready by Friday. My number is five five five, two zero one nine. Thanks.

Good morning, everyone, and welcome to your first day at Norton Electronics. I'm Karen, and I'll be guiding you through this orientation. This morning, we'll tour the factory floor so you can see how our products are assembled. After lunch in the cafeteria, you'll meet your team supervisors. Before we start, please put on the safety glasses on the table by the door. They are required in all production areas.

Are you tired of spending your weekends cleaning? Let Sparkle Home Services do the work for you! Our trained staff clean houses and apartments of every size, and we use only environmentally friendly products. This month only, new customers get twenty percent off their first cleaning. To book, visit our website or download our mobile app. Sparkle Home Services: more time for the things you love.

Before we finish, I have an update about the office move. The new building on Elm Street won't be ready until the end of next month, because the electrical work is taking longer than planned. So we'll stay here for now. I know many of you have already started packing. Please don't put any more files in boxes until we confirm the new date. I'll send everyone an e-mail as soon as the contractor gives me a schedule.
